walkthroughs.body_html:
An element contains one type of atom.

A compound contains atoms of two or more elements chemically bonded.

Mixtures can be separated physically; compounds need a chemical reaction.

Group 1 metals are +1; Group 2 are +2; Group 7 are -1.

Cross over charges: Ca^2+ and Cl^- gives CaCl2.

Common ions: SO4^2-, NO3^-, OH^-, CO3^2-, NH4^+.

Atoms are conserved - same number each side.

Mg + O2 -> MgO. Balance: 2Mg + O2 -> 2MgO.

Add state symbols: (s), (l), (g), (aq).
